subject.title: fix(cron): support current and session: targets in initial delivery resolution

question: Should direct `CronService.add` and declarative convergence persist `{ mode: "announce" }` for `current` and `session:*` output jobs, matching normalized creation and runtime delivery planning?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes a compatibility-sensitive stored default at the direct-service boundary; the implementation is centralized, but confirming that persistence contract requires cron-owner intent.

options.title: Confirm the unified persistence contract
options.body: Keep the shared predicate and merge after current-head proof shows that direct-service and Gateway creation retain the intended announce behavior.

options.title: Limit defaults to normalized creation
options.body: Retain the existing direct-service behavior and remove the persistence default if callers that bypass normalization must continue storing no delivery.

recommendation.title: Confirm the unified persistence contract
recommendation.body: Keep the shared predicate and merge after current-head proof shows that direct-service and Gateway creation retain the intended announce behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commits on this branch and the related persistent-session restoration make steipete the strongest available routing candidate for the cron delivery contract.
